observation: All processes complete with the atomic expiry fix, but movement continuity and server/client timing acceptance remain unproven. The exact admission-expiry refusal is not observed in this capture.
limits: The raw v6 profile calls all control discontinuities intentional; the normalized run uses control_discontinuity_meters. Displacements include the accepted Misty Step and epoch changes, not just unexpected recovery.
Aggregate epoch counts include interval entry and other lifecycle transitions; they are not direct expiry counts.
Persistence and GPU timestamps are disabled; headless clients use legacy movement.
The delayed proxy sleeps serially per TCP read chunk, not at fixed end-to-end RTT.
Shared hardware and external builds prevent an isolated performance comparison.
